scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.description: Customer service tickets and knowledge base
app.access_detail: Admin configures OAuth client; distributed integrations require a global OAuth client.
app.surface: REST; tickets, users, help center and voice
app.note: API tokens are deprecated and unavailable for new accounts from July 28, 2026; migrate to OAuth.
app.workflow: Read a Zendesk test ticket using OAuth
app.next_action: Configure OAuth for a test Zendesk account and read a seeded ticket; avoid new integration instructions that require deprecated API tokens.
app.success_criterion: Retrieve the ticket and document granted scopes plus the account's OAuth setup permissions.
app.alternative_action: For an older customer installation, inventory token dependencies and create an OAuth migration checklist.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
